displayIdentity.body: Macedonian poverty overflows in generosity. Moreover, brothers, we make known to you the grace of God which has been given in the assemblies of Macedonia, But as you abound in everything—in faith, utterance, knowledge, all earnestness, and in your love to us—see that you also abound in this grace.
